description: Row-wise softmax over a row-major [rows, N] float32 matrix; one CTA per row.
signature: extern "C" __global__ void <name>(const float* x, float* y, int N)

variants.name: softmax_ref
variants.notes: one thread per row, serial loops; obviously correct

variants.name: softmax_opt
variants.notes: shared-memory tree reductions for max and sum, multiply by reciprocal

variants.name: softmax_bug_nosync

bug.change: removed __syncthreads() inside the max reduction loop

variants.expect_note: missing barrier -> race on shared memory

variants.name: softmax_bug_tail

bug.change: reduction loops stop at (N/BLOCK)*BLOCK, dropping the tail

variants.expect_note: bug only exists when N % block != 0, so VOLTA must be run with such an N

variants.name: softmax_bug_offbyone

bug.change: sum loop uses i <= N (reads one element of the next row)

variants.expect_note: denominator includes one element of the next row

variants.name: softmax_bug_nomax

bug.change: no max subtraction before exp (overflows for large x)

variants.expect_note: BLIND SPOT: equal over the reals; only float overflow differs
